patterns.note: A full-bleed video hero dominates the initial viewport, setting a mood rather than presenting immediate calls to action.
Product grids feature generous whitespace around each item, typically displaying four columns on wider screens, creating an airy and uncluttered presentation.
All text, including navigation, headings, and product details, consistently uses a clean, minimal sans-serif typeface, with uppercase applied to navigation links and section titles for emphasis.
The design relies on a predominantly monochromatic palette of white backgrounds and black text, allowing the natural colors of product photography and the hero video to provide visual interest.
A fixed 'Q&A' button remains visible and accessible in the bottom right corner of the viewport, persisting across all scroll depths.
Editorial-style sections, such as 'MONOHA EXHIBITION', are interspersed with product grids, featuring large, high-quality imagery and minimal descriptive text to convey a sense of craft and artistry.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-width, auto-playing video as the primary hero element, designed to immediately immerse the user in the brand's aesthetic without requiring interaction.
A fixed-position call-to-action button (Q&A) is implemented using CSS positioning to ensure it remains visible and clickable regardless of the user's scroll depth.
Content sections below the hero are revealed through standard vertical scrolling, appearing statically as they enter the viewport without complex scroll-triggered animations or staggered fade-ins.

design_tokens.type_scale: A relatively flat type scale with small, legible body text and navigation, and section headings only slightly larger, contributing to an understated and minimal aesthetic.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used consistently across all elements, including product images, buttons, and content containers, reinforcing a clean and precise visual character.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and balanced, characterized by significant whitespace around elements and between grid items, which enhances readability and contributes to a premium, uncluttered presentation.

standout: The site's distinctive quality lies in its serene, almost meditative presentation, achieved through a full-bleed video hero, a strictly monochromatic palette, and an abundance of whitespace. It elevates product display to an art exhibition, focusing on the aesthetic and craft rather than aggressive sales tactics.
